feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 27 May 2026 10:11pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 27 May 2026 at 9:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure is centred in the North Sea.


##Wind##

East or southeast 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in/around showers overnight. Decreasing southeast 4 or 5 tomorrow morning, then 3 or 4 tomorrow afternoon, veering south or southwest 4 to 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate becoming mainly moderate tomorrow evening.


##Weather##

Scattered showers at first tonight clearing to become mainly fair by tomorrow morning, then the risk of some coastal mist/fog patches developing from the south later in the afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers overnight. Falling poor in mist or any fog patches tomorrow afternoon.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 overnight into Friday, then 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate falling slight or moderate on Friday.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
